page_title: WOL 1-1 BRE | Wolves v Brentford 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Tom King.
90+4' There's an opportunity for Mathias Jensen (Brentford) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

90+2' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
90+1' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jose Sa will be replaced by Tom King (Wolves).
90+1' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) for Matt Doherty.
86' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Michael Kayode will be replaced by Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford).
86' It's time for a substitution. Santiago Bueno (Wolves) comes on in place of Marshall Munetsi.
86' Igor Thiago (Brentford) gets on the end of a cross but produces a tame shot from the edge of the area which goes well wide of the right post.
86' The shots on goal statistics – 6:7.
85' A pass from Igor Thiago (Brentford) is intercepted by Jose Sa and the move breaks down.
83' The resulting corner from Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is cleared.
83' Joao Gomes (Wolves) tries to find Jorgen Strand Larsen, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
80' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Kevin Schade and he is replaced by Igor Thiago (Brentford).
80' A substitution has been made. Mikkel Damsgaard goes off and Mathias Jensen (Brentford) comes on.
80' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
79' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt is neither hard nor precise, so Jose Sa stops it easily.
77' The ball is cleared after Yoane Wissa (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
77' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
75' 1 - 1 An excellent first touch by Marshall Munetsi (Wolves), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!
73' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is penalised for holding. Craig Pawson signals a set piece.
72' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Nelson Semedo (Wolves) receives a yellow card!
72' Joao Gomes (Wolves) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Mark Flekken comes off his line to intercept.
70' The corner from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is hurriedly cleared.
69' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
68' Joao Gomes (Wolves) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
65' Vitor Pereira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) replacing Goncalo Guedes.
65' A substitution has been made. Rayan Ait Nouri is replaced by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves).
65' Some patient build-up play from Brentford as they look to unlock the defence.

64' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Jose Sa.
62' Michael Kayode (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yoane Wissa (Brentford) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Kevin Schade (Brentford) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
58' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Marshall Munetsi. It's a good effort but just misses the left post.
56' Matt Doherty (Wolves) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the left post.
55' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) steps up to send the ball in.
55' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Matheus Cunha (Wolves). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
54' Bryan Mbeumo plays a lovely pass into Yoane Wissa (Brentford), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
52' Craig Pawson blows his whistle and it's Nelson Semedo (Wolves) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
51' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
51' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
50' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the top left corner. However, Mark Flekken anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
50' Andre (Wolves) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
49' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
48' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
48' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

48' Matt Doherty (Wolves) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
47' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
46' Referee Craig Pawson blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Wolves fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.

45+1' A big opportunity is wasted by Nelson Semedo (Wolves), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Mark Flekken pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the left post. His promising effort is kept out by Jose Sa, who pulls off a stunning save!
43' Goncalo Guedes plays a pass into the path of Andre (Wolves), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
41' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) hits a first-time volley towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is an easy save for the goalkeeper.
41' Matt Doherty (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' The percentage of ball possession is – 54:46.
38' Good movement by Kevin Schade (Brentford), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
37' CHANCE! Yoane Wissa finds Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar!
36' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Jose Sa.
35' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Joao Gomes (Wolves) for his blatant foul.

34' An accurate cross finds its way to Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box. The ball bounces up off the ground but the goalkeeper saves.
33' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
31' An attempted cross from Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) is cleared.
30' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
30' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
30' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
29' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
28' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Jose Sa.
27' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
26' Foul! Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
24' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) commits a foul and Craig Pawson immediately signals a free kick.
22' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
20' 0 - 1 Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) collects a delightful pass inside the box and slashes the ball into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
19' Wolves keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
17' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
16' Jose Sa makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) after a cross from the side.

15' Mark Flekken makes a brilliant save! Nelson Semedo (Wolves) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
13' My Gran could have done better! Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
13' Kevin Schade (Brentford) dribbles into the box, but Jose Sa is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
11' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken is prepared to thwart his effort.
9' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
8' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
6' Michael Kayode (Brentford) makes a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Kevin Schade (Brentford) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
2' Brentford are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' The players are out and the match is about to start. Brentford will have the kick-off.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
